verified_contracts: A Router model receives only the OWA plan and status capabilities in agent mode. A forged files_read call creates no action.
Worker tool references resolve against the installed catalog and current Agent policy. A Worker requires owner approval for a private workspace write.
The owner's profile is present in the Router request and excluded from the Worker request.
Three blocked Workers leave room for an actual Router response; an independent fourth Worker remains queued.
A new Web session receives the ordinary V2 response and does not create an OWA execution for the same Agent.
